panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 6 panels (A, B, C, D, E, F). A: CT image showing a space-occupying mass at the bronchial opening, consistent with bronchial mucoepidermoid carcinoma. B: CT image demonstrating space-occupying lesion in the right upper lobe, highly suggestive of bronchial mucoepidermoid carcinoma. C: CT image showing atelectasis likely secondary to the central tumor, consistent with clinical findings of bronchial mucoepidermoid carcinoma. D: Endoscopy clearly visualizes a suspicious, ball-shaped mass in the bronchial lumen, correlating with the known diagnosis of bronchial mucoepidermoid carcinoma. E: Standard histological evaluation (H&E) confirming the diagnosis of pulmonary mucoepidermoid carcinoma. F: Immunohistochemical staining (CK) confirming the diagnosis of the carcinoma.
